{{Short description|Indian hotel chain}} {{Use dmy dates|date=January 2018}} {{Use Indian English|date=January 2018}} {{Infobox company | name = ITC Hotels | logo = ITC Hotels logo.svg | image = ITC Royal Bengalz.jpg | image_caption = [[ITC Royal Bengal]] in Kolkata | type = [[Public company|Public]] | founded = {{start date and age|1975}} | traded_as = {{NSE|ITCHOTELS}}
{{BSE|544325}} | hq_location_city = [[Kolkata]], [[West Bengal]], India[https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/itchotels/history/ITC01 ITC Hotels Company Details] | hq_location_country = | num_locations = 70+ | area_served = India, Sri Lanka | key_people = Anil Chadha {{small|(MD & CEO)}} | industry = [[Hospitality]] | brands = {{hlist | ITC Hotels | Mementos | Welcomhotel | Storii | Fortune Hotels | WelcomHeritage}} | revenue = {{up}} {{INRConvert|3103|c}} (FY2024){{Cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/9051ab5f-3cc6-42ea-8109-7fc87513824a.pdf|title=ITC Q4FY24 results}}{{Dead link|date=February 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} | net_income = {{up}} {{INRConvert|765|c}} (FY2024) | assets = {{up}} {{INRConvert|8765|c}} (FY2024) | owner = [[ITC Limited]] (1975–2025) | parent = | website = {{URL|https://www.itchotels.com}} }} '''ITC Hotels''' is an Indian [[hospitality company]] that operates and manages [[hotels]]. It has over 100 hotels and is India's third largest hotel chain.{{cn|date=December 2025}} It has a franchise agreement to operate most of its hotels as part of [[The Luxury Collection]] of [[Marriott International]]. ITC Hotels was a subsidiary of [[ITC Limited]] until its demerger in 2025.{{cite news |last1=Agarwal |first1=Nikhil |title=ITC Hotels demerger comes into effect tomorrow. What's in it for shareholders? |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/itc-hotels-demerger-comes-into-effect-tomorrow-whats-in-it-for-shareholders/articleshow/116817243.cms |access-date=17 February 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=31 December 2024}} ==History== [[File:ITC Kohenur on Inorbit Mall Road (2).jpg|thumb|ITC Kohenur, [[Hyderabad]]]] The [[ITC Limited|India Tobacco Company]] entered the hotel business on 18 October 1975, with the opening of the [[Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Cathedral Road, Chennai|Chola Hotel]] in [[Chennai]].{{cite web |title= About us |publisher= ITC Hotels | url=https://www.itchotels.in/about.html}} In 1979, as ITC's Welcome group hotel chain grew, it partnered with [[Sheraton Hotels]] to brand many of their properties as Sheratons.{{cite web | url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/economy/story/19790415-10-year-old-link-between-oberoi-hotel-group-and-sheraton-hotels-snaps-821942-2014-03-03 | title=10-year-old link between Oberoi hotel group and Sheraton hotels snaps | date=3 March 2014 }} Originally incorporated as Rama Hotels Pvt Ltd in 1972[https://www.zaubacorp.com/company/HOTEL-RAMA-PRIVATE-LIMITED/U55102KA1972PTC002152= Rama Hotels Pvt Ltd] ''Zauba Corp'' and renamed Vishwarama Hotels in 1973, the Vazir Sultan Tobacco Co Ltd. ([[VST Industries]]) bought Vishwarama Hotels in 1980–1981 and soon after, in 1982, the first luxury hotel for the new chain opened in [[Bangalore]]. In 1984, ITC bought the entire equity capital from VST. In 1985, the Indian government awarded the hotel that would later become the ITC Gardenia a five-star rating. The company name was changed to ITC Hotels in 1986.[https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/itchotels/history/itc01= Company Facts – ITC Hotels]. ''moneycontrol.com''. ITC Hotels hosted many visiting royalty and world leaders, including [[George W. Bush]], [[Vladimir Putin]], [[Barack Obama]]{{cite news|url=http://www.rediff.com/news/2006/mar/01bush29.htm|title=President Bush arrives|date=1 March 2006|work=[[Rediff]]|access-date=27 July 2010}}{{cite news|url=http://www.rediff.com/news/2000/oct/02putin.htm |title=Chandragupta ready to host Putin |last=Joseph|first=Josy|date=2 October 2000|work=[[Rediff]]|access-date=27 July 2010 |location=New Delhi}}{{cite news|url=http://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/obama-visit-us-wants-no-fly-zone-over-itc-maurya-taj-mahal/article1-1309459.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150121212935/http://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/obama-visit-us-wants-no-fly-zone-over-itc-maurya-taj-mahal/article1-1309459.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=21 January 2015|title=Obama visit: US wants no-fly zone over ITC Maurya, Taj |date=26 January 2015|work=[[hindustantimes]]}} and [[Donald Trump]].{{Cite web |title=Trump to stay at ITC Maurya's Chanakya Suite; here's how much it costs a night |date=24 February 2020 |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/economy-politics/story/donald-trump-itc-maurya-chanakya-suite-how-much-costs-night-250726-2020-02-24}} In September 2023, [[ITC Limited]] announced the [[demerger]] of its hotel business.{{cite web |date=25 September 2023 |title=Behind ITC's Hotels Demerger |url=https://www.business-standard.com/opinion/columns/behind-itc-s-hotels-demerger-123092501279_1.html |publisher=Business Standard}}{{cite web |date=26 September 2023 |title=ITC CMD Sanjiv Puri Exclusive Interview |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/itc-share-price-cmd-sanjiv-puri-exclusive-interview-hotel-business-demerger-capital-raise-debt-expansion-17875601.htm |publisher=CNBC TV18}}{{cite web |date=26 September 2023 |title=ITC Hotel Spinoff at 10:1 Ratio, IPO in 15 Months |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/itc-hotel-spinoff-at-10-1-ratio-ipo-in-15-months-11692038297794.html |publisher=Livemint}}{{cite web |date=5 August 2023 |title=ITC Hotels Listing Likely in 2024, Company Board to Take Decision on August 14 |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/itc-hotels-listing-in-2024-company-board-to-take-decision-on-august-14-report-392945-2023-08-05 |publisher=Business Today}} The ITC Hotels demerger came into effect on 1 January 2025. Shareholders of ITC Limited were allotted one share of ITC Hotels for every 10 shares of the parent company.{{Cite web |date=2025-01-01 |title=ITC Hotels demerger comes into effect today - What it means for investors |url=https://www.etnownews.com/markets/itc-hotels-demerger-comes-into-effect-today-what-it-means-for-investors-article-116844111 |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=ET Now |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=ITC Hotels Demerger: What Investors Need to Know and How to Participate in the Growth Story – Stock Market |url=https://www.hpbl.co.in/news/itc-hotels-demerger-what-investors-need-to-know-and-how-to-participate-in-the-growth-story/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |date=2025-01-01 |title=ITC Hotels demerger: Stock listing date, share price calculation, F&O inclusion & more |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/itc-hotels-demerger-stock-listing-date-share-price-calculation-fo-inclusion-more-459177-2025-01-01 |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Business Today |language=en}} ==Brands== The group today operates under several distinct brands:{{citation needed|date=April 2024}} *'''ITC Hotels''', which has 17 hotels *'''Mementos''', which has 2 hotels *'''Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels''', which has 25 hotels *'''Storii By ITC Hotels''', which has 6 hotels *'''Fortune Hotels''', which has 53 hotels *'''WelcomHeritage''', which has 3 hotels ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Official website|www.itchotels.com}} {{ITC}} {{Hotel chains}} [[Category:Hotel chains in India]] [[Category:Hotels established in 1975]] [[Category:Companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:1975 establishments in West Bengal]] [[Category:ITC Limited]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract:
ITC Hotels is an Indian hospitality company that operates and manages hotels. It has over 100 hotels and is India's third largest hotel chain. It has a franchise agreement to operate most of its hotels as part of The Luxury Collection of Marriott International.
ITC Hotels was a subsidiary of ITC Limited until its demerger in 2025.
